scope: private lesson incident vault production enablement boundary

zero_spend_runtime_boundary.current_source_dependency: the pre-existing generalized lesson runtime still contains an OpenAI API anonymizer path
zero_spend_runtime_boundary.production_activation_status: blocked until the generalized lesson path is made zero-spend or a newer explicit owner authorization supersedes the zero-spend policy
zero_spend_runtime_boundary.source_merge_effect: source review/merge alone does not invoke the anonymizer or authorize production activation

intended_persistent_volume.path_requirement: absolute owner-private directory on a persistent private volume

required_behavior: directory remains present across ordinary service restart
ciphertext envelopes remain present across host/container remount or redeploy
vault refuses symlinked or non-owned directories
authenticated read-back succeeds for previously captured records after remount-equivalent recovery
mount_and_remount_semantics.production_remount_test_status: not_performed; production infrastructure change is not authorized

ownership_and_permissions.ownership_policy: reject if the root is not owned by the runtime uid

encryption_secret_source_and_injection.key_requirement: 32 random bytes encoded as unpadded base64url
encryption_secret_source_and_injection.secret_storage_requirement: production secret manager or service environment secret; never Git, logs, CI artifacts, PR text, or ciphertext backup

restart_behavior.expected: after service restart with the same directory, key, and key ID, existing encrypted incident envelopes are readable and their incident digests match

host_container_remount_or_redeploy_behav.expected: after remount or redeploy, the same persistent private volume is mounted at ASKRIGOR_LESSON_INCIDENT_DIRECTORY before service start
host_container_remount_or_redeploy_behav.acceptance_test_required_before_producti: capture synthetic record, stop service, restart/reconstruct service, remount/reopen the persistent volume as applicable, and authenticated read-back with digest match

backup_and_recovery.backup_contents: ciphertext envelopes and non-secret envelope metadata only
backup_and_recovery.restore_requirement: restore ciphertext files to a private owned 0700 directory and verify authenticated read-back with unchanged incident_sha256 using the externally supplied key

rollback.safe_runtime_rollback: unset ASKRIGOR_LESSON_INCIDENT_DIRECTORY, ASKRIGOR_LESSON_INCIDENT_KEY, and ASKRIGOR_LESSON_INCIDENT_KEY_ID or roll back the service image; current lesson handling must then fail closed at private incident capture and must not submit the generalized lesson as if exact preservation succeeded
rollback.data_rollback: preserve ciphertext backups unless a separately authorized retention/deletion decision exists
rollback.key_rollback: restore the previous external key and key ID only through secret storage; never commit key material

exact_production_changes_still_required: replace or disable the paid model API anonymizer in the generalized lesson path to satisfy the current zero-spend owner policy, unless a newer explicit owner authorization supersedes it
choose the production persistent private volume and final directory path
create or verify the production directory with the runtime service owner and 0700-or-stricter mode
generate and install ASKRIGOR_LESSON_INCIDENT_KEY through production secret storage
run the production restart/remount acceptance test with synthetic data only
define ciphertext-only backup and restore handling
document retention, key rotation, and deletion authority
obtain separate production deployment/merge authorization if the PR merge is production-coupled
